composer.placeholder.before: Ask anything — Enter to send (queues while replying), Ctrl+Enter to interrupt & send

empty.body.before: Ask about any subject, drop in a photo of your work, or hold the mic and just say it.
empty.body.after: Ask a question, add a photo, or use the mic.

fineprint.before: Muta runs entirely on this machine. Answers can be wrong — check the working.
fineprint.after: Muta can make mistakes. Check important info.

model.defaultRecommended.before: The recommended model is selected by default.

model.operatorOnly.before: Only the laptop operator can change the shared tutor model.
model.operatorOnly.after: Only the host can change the model.

model.outsideRegistry.before: The current engine is outside this registry. Choose an installed tutor model.

model.switchUncertain.before: The switch may still be completing. Choices stay locked until Muta reconnects.

settings.languageHelp.before: Sets Muta’s response language. Complete interface translations change the menus too. Auto follows your browser for the interface and your latest message for each reply.
settings.languageHelp.after: Auto mode detects your language and replies in it.

settings.parallelHelp.before: Keep one reply running while you start another. Parallel replies share the local CPU and may each run more slowly.
settings.parallelHelp.after: Parallel replies share same CPU and RAM. Queue queries to optimize resources.
